manuscript_title: CoordRep: A Canonical, Continuous, and Compositional Representation for Machine Learning in Coordination Chemistry
purpose: Publication-facing implementation, Figures 1-6, Supplementary Figures S1-S2, and all-metal April 2025 CSD structural-record audit aggregates

canonicalization.compatibility_boundary: Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure S1 are rc3 canonicalization evidence. Figure 6A-C report rc3 re-encoding of the exactly unchanged frozen molecular-family cohort. Figure 6D-E use the separate periodic-v3 construction.

property_figure_4.scope_boundary: The active Figure 4, source table, and caption reproduce the manuscript benchmark. No Figure 4 model or metric is relabelled as rc3, and no post-canonicalizer retraining claim is made.

molecular_figure_6.construction: Frozen rc2-selected molecular family cohort re-encoded with CoordRep 1.1.2rc3
molecular_figure_6.active_family_cohort: 3491 families; 9056 records; membership exactly unchanged; no missing L0-L3 keys
molecular_figure_6.scope_boundary: Frozen selection denominators and rc3 end-to-end eligibility are distinct; Figure 6 uses the exactly unchanged frozen cohort and reports rc3 identity values.

full_csd_audit.runtime: Python 3.10.19; CCDC Python API 3.6.0; NumPy 2.2.6; SciPy 1.13.1
full_csd_audit.scope_boundary: Source-faithful structural transcription from the native CSD molecular bond graph; no distance-derived contacts are added; exact identity and CShM are not guaranteed for every site.

redistribution.included: Code, protocols, aggregate/public source tables, artwork, synchronized audit methods and Table S9 excerpt, small synthetic controls, and cryptographic commitments
redistribution.excluded: Raw CSD coordinates, raw CSD structure files, and licensed row-level CSD ledgers
